text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3.Transcript of postgraduate school 4.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above 5.Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.
